q: Period-doubling cascade to chaos (as studied by Feigenbaum) is a universal route with the convergence ratio of parameter intervals satisfying:
exp: Feigenbaum's constant δ ≈ 4.66920… is universal: consecutive period-doubling bifurcation parameter values satisfy (μₙ₊₁ − μₙ)/(μₙ₊₂ − μₙ₊₁) → δ for any smooth one-parameter family in this universality class.
